metadata.title: CrateFit - 3D Bin Packing Made Simple
metadata.description: Open-source 3D bin packing library for container loading, pallet packing, and logistics optimization.

hero.badge: v0.1.1 released with online packing support
hero.title: 3D Bin Packing
hero.description: Open-source TypeScript library for container loading, pallet packing, and logistics optimization. Multiple algorithms, real-time visualization, and constraint support out of the box.

features.title: Everything you need for bin packing
features.description: A comprehensive solution for 3D bin packing with flexible algorithms and extensive constraint support.

multipleAlgorithms.title: Multiple Algorithms
multipleAlgorithms.description: Extreme Point, Layer Building, and EB-AFIT algorithms optimized for different use cases.

visualization.title: 3D Visualization
visualization.description: Built-in Canvas 2D and Three.js 3D rendering for real-time packing visualization.

typescript.title: TypeScript Native
typescript.description: Written in TypeScript with full type definitions. Zero runtime dependencies.

weight.title: Weight Constraints
weight.description: Support for item weights, max container weight, and weight distribution.

rotation.description: Configure allowed rotations per item. Support for orientation constraints.

stacking.title: Stacking Rules
stacking.description: Define stacking limits and fragility constraints for safe packing.

online.title: Online Packing
online.description: Real-time incremental packing as items arrive. Perfect for conveyor systems.

performance.title: High Performance
performance.description: Optimized algorithms capable of handling thousands of items efficiently.

useCases.title: Built for real-world logistics

footer.description: 3D bin packing library for logistics optimization.

pricing.title: Completely Free
pricing.description: CrateFit is completely free. Use the SDK, Public API, or self-host your own instance.

sdk.name: SDK
sdk.description: Use the library directly in your application

api.name: Public API
api.notice: Intended for testing and demonstration. Endpoints may change without notice. For production workloads, we recommend self-hosting.

selfHosted.name: Self-Hosted
selfHosted.description: Run your own instance with no restrictions

whyFree.a: We believe bin packing tools should be accessible to everyone. CrateFit is free for both personal and commercial use.

rateLimits.q: What are the API rate limits?
rateLimits.a: The Public API allows 60 requests per minute per IP address. This is sufficient for most use cases. For higher throughput, self-host your own instance.

selfHost.a: Absolutely. Check out our deployment guide to run your own CrateFit API server with no restrictions.

commercial.a: Yes. Commercial use is permitted without obtaining a separate license. You can freely use the SDK and API in commercial products and services.

support.a: For commercial support, custom development, or enterprise consulting, please reach out via GitHub Issues or email.
